Birth rate collapse in civilizations throughout history occurs whenever there is a long period of prosperity and no serious external threats. Rome had a very high birth rate during existential wars with Carthage and then very low after they had destroyed all external threats and had several generations of prosperity. There was a demographic problem 2,200 years ago, and Polybius wrote exactly what caused it.
